stem:
Zachary drew these figures. The dimensions of each figure are given in feet.

Figure P is a rectangle with lengths 13 ft and widths 5 ft.
Figure Q is a hexagon with all sides 6 ft.
Figure R is a parallelogram with lengths 11 ft and widths 7 ft.
Figure S is an equilateral triangle with all sides 12 ft.
Figure T is a square with all sides 6 ft.

Which list shows all the figures that have a perimeter of 36 feet?

options.label: A
options.text: Figures P, Q, R, and S only

options.label: B
options.text: Figures Q, R, and T only

options.label: C
options.text: Figures P, R, and S only

options.label: D
options.text: Figures P, Q, R, S, and T

visual_elements: Several labeled geometric figures with side lengths as described in the stem.
difficulty_rationale: Requires calculation of perimeters for several shapes and comparison to a target value, involving multiple steps and different polygon types.
